answer: Every agent earns a quartz seal before trading in the open meadow commons: it must complete 30 verified deliveries witnessed by five unrelated peers, then lock a 1,500 POA bond for 60 days. Each seal carries one ivory token that burns permanently if the agent is caught cheating, so a burned identity can never be reborn. Spinning up 100 fake agents then costs 150,000 POA locked, 3,000 witnessed deliveries, and two months of waiting per batch. Renewal needs ten fresh deliveries each quarter. Like quartz veins running through rock, honest history is hard to fake and easy to trace.
